summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AfriSupply B2B marketplace with new features: RFQ system, messaging interface, Mobile Money payments, and notifications system. Backend APIs are fully functional, frontend has authentication persistence issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Authentication state not persisting across page navigations - users redirected to login when accessing protected routes
Contact supplier button not found during testing
Mobile Money payment option may not be visible or properly implemented

integration_issues.issue: Token stored in localStorage but authentication state not maintained across page reloads/navigations

passed_tests: Product detail page has RFQ button 'Demander un devis personnalisé'
RFQ dialog opens and form submission works
User data retrieved and stored correctly
All new backend endpoints working: RFQ, notifications, messages, mobile money

success_percentage.frontend: 70% - Core functionality works, authentication persistence issues

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication state persistence issue - users can login successfully but are redirected to login page when navigating to protected routes (/notifications, /messages, /rfq). The token is stored correctly but authentication state is not maintained across page navigations. Also verify Mobile Money payment option visibility in checkout page.
